integrity: An elementary normal form and the unrefined diamond count are prior published work and are explicitly credited. Only the maximal commutation classification and all-arity formula are asserted as novel. Mathematical proof is accompanied by finite independent checks; no external independent audit was performed.
limitations: Applies to extensive isotone idempotent self-maps on labelled finite atom-diamond lattices of width at least three, without additivity or meet preservation; generalization to other lattice families is not claimed. A source might contain an equivalent result under other terminology.
title: Maximal commuting families of closure modalities on finite diamond lattices
